# pensiv Plugins

> Public monorepo for the pensiv plugin ecosystem. A pensiv plugin is a small
> TypeScript package authored against the typed
> `@pensiv/plugin-sdk` (a `Plugin` base class + a permission-gated Host API),
> built to an ES module the pensiv writing app installs. First-party plugins live
> here too and install through the same pipeline — nothing is baked into the app.

## Start here

- [Agent reference](AGENTS.md): the full authoring contract — manifest,
  lifecycle, what you can register, the Host API, permissions, settings schema.
- [Sample plugin](plugins/sample-plugin/src/main.ts): the canonical
  clone-and-edit starter (minimal shape — one command + settings tab).
- [Surface actions plugin](plugins/surface-actions): the reference for
  registerSurfaceItem — every surface in the catalogue, the two scoping knobs
  (static `fileTypes` vs dynamic `when`), and a deliberately-crashing row that
  shows the host's throw guard disabling one item rather than the menu.
- [Canvas checklist plugin](plugins/canvas-checklist): the reference for
  registerCanvasNode — the host/plugin split, `setState` returning false at the
  size cap, honouring `readOnly` in history/export renders, and how to make a
  plugin node look native (task-list checkbox, goal-widget track, ghost buttons,
  all from host tokens).
- [Writing time plugin](plugins/writing-time): the reference for the session
  lifecycle — `activeMs` + the write-start/write-stop/tick stream, one shared
  hook behind a floating card, a tray chip and a `@pensiv/plugin-ui` sheet.
- [Paragraph analysis plugin](plugins/paragraph-analysis): the reference for a
  read-only analysis plugin — walking `editor.getDoc()` (not `getText()`, which
  erases empty paragraphs) behind a debounced side pane, the same walker over
  `project.content(id).doc` for a manuscript-wide scope, a declarative settings
  form feeding a pure engine, and an analytics section reusing those numbers.
- [Graph tags plugin](plugins/graph-tags): the reference for the relationship
  graph — a #tag overlay as virtual nodes, a togglable filter, a graph toolbar
  button and a node-menu row, plus a guarded paintNode.
- [Timer plugin](plugins/timer): the reference for non-trivial plugins. Read
  AGENTS.md "Reference plugin: Timer" for the patterns it encodes — one shared
  singleton store across surfaces, ephemeral run-state vs durable `app.storage`,
  a multi-surface `registerWidget` (floating + chip + sheet), and the i18n recipe.

## Per-plugin developer notes (DEVELOPER.md)

Plugin `README.md` files are user-facing only — they seed the marketplace
listing description, so they carry no implementation detail. The engineering
write-ups (design decisions, host-API patterns, traps) live in each plugin's
`DEVELOPER.md`:

- [Calculator](plugins/calculator/DEVELOPER.md): pure state-machine engine,
  run-state vs durable settings, pane-not-dialog, panel-scoped keyboard.
- [Date calculator](plugins/date-calculator/DEVELOPER.md): civil dates instead
  of `Date` objects, round-tripping diffs, the 29 February convention.
- [Unit converter](plugins/unit-converter/DEVELOPER.md): ratio tables with exact
  definitions, temperature as functions, historical units as a filter.
- [Pomodoro basic](plugins/pomodoro-basic/DEVELOPER.md): wall-clock countdown
  that survives renderer throttling, the CSS-only dial, accent-only phase colour.
- [Foreshadowing](plugins/foreshadowing/DEVELOPER.md): anchoring plugin data to
  prose — the mark IS the database, writing to off-screen files, `target.range`.
- [Paragraph analysis](plugins/paragraph-analysis/DEVELOPER.md): `getDoc()` over
  `getText()`, debounced walks, porting app chrome without the card shell.
- [Canvas checklist](plugins/canvas-checklist/DEVELOPER.md): the host/plugin
  split for canvas nodes, the 16 KB state cap, deterministic ids, `readOnly`.
- [Writing time](plugins/writing-time/DEVELOPER.md): the session lifecycle,
  what `activeMs` measures, three surfaces from one hook.
- [Status window](plugins/status-window/DEVELOPER.md): the template language,
  permissions rationale, build commands.

## SDK contract (read these for exact types)

- [Plugin base class](packages/plugin-sdk/src/plugin.ts): onload/onunload,
  addCommand, registerWidget, registerEditorExtension, addSettingTab, …
- [Host API](packages/plugin-sdk/src/host-api.ts): app.editor / project /
  session / storage / ui / platform / app. Cross-file text lives on
  app.project.content(id) → {doc, text} for documents and sheets; navigating to
  it is app.ui.openFile(id, { range }).
- [Contributions & settings schema](packages/plugin-sdk/src/contributions.ts):
  header/pane/sidebar contributions and the declarative SettingsSchema.
- [Surface catalogue](packages/plugin-sdk/src/surfaces.ts): registerSurfaceItem
  and the stable surface ids — file.menu, editor.menu, editor.selection,
  plotcard.menu, plotpartcard.menu, canvas.selection, pane.toolbar,
  pane.statusbar, analytics.section. The editor surfaces carry target.range
  ({from,to}), snapshotted when the surface opened; editor.selection (the
  floating toolbar) is the one that exists on phones and tablets too.
- [Canvas nodes](packages/plugin-sdk/src/canvas-node.ts): registerCanvasNode —
  a plugin-owned node on the canvas, with a 16 KB state cap.
- [Graph contributions](packages/plugin-sdk/src/graph.ts): registerGraphSource /
  registerGraphFilter — virtual nodes, links, filters, and a guarded paintNode.
- [Widget contribution](packages/plugin-sdk/src/widget.ts).
- [Data model](packages/plugin-sdk/src/types.ts): manifest, permissions,
  installed-entry.

## Build

- [Shared vite config](packages/build-config/vite.shared.js): externalizes
  react + @pensiv/plugin-sdk; emits main.js (+ styles.css).

## Notes

- Code plugins target desktop/web. Mobile (iOS) cannot run downloaded code
  (Apple §2.5.2); declarative-only support comes later.
- The SDK is mirror-generated from the pensiv app; the published .d.ts is the
  source of truth for authors.

## Publishing

- Marketplace publishing is SOURCE-based: submit manifest.json + src/** at
  https://pensiv.so/community/publish/plugin (or in-app: Settings → Plugins →
  Publish a plugin). The server builds it; imports beyond the host modules
  (react, react-dom, react/jsx-runtime, @pensiv/plugin-sdk, @pensiv/plugin-ui,
  @tiptap/core, @tiptap/pm/*) are rejected. Caps: 100 files / 2 MB / 512 KB per file.
- ProseMirror MUST come from the host (@tiptap/pm/*), never from your own
  dependency. Two copies mean the host's `instanceof` checks fail: a plugin-made
  DecorationSet poisons the editor's DecorationGroup and every redraw then throws
  "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'localsInner')".
- Every fetch host needs a `net:<host>` permission; so.pensiv.* ids are
  reserved. Manifest version must strictly increase per republish.
- Listings start as "Unreviewed" — permissions are displayed, and the app asks
  for consent before running plugin code. See AGENTS.md "Publishing to the
  marketplace" for the full rules.
